nodes.label: Shared Package Architecture
nodes.rationale: NetworkScanKit remains independent, NetMonitorCore integrates it, and both applications consume NetMonitorCore so shared contracts have a deliberate one-way dependency flow.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Integration Point
nodes.rationale: NetMonitorCore centralizes models, protocols, and platform-agnostic services so macOS and iOS share the same behavioral contracts.

nodes.label: Protocol-First Strict Concurrency
nodes.rationale: Capabilities are expressed as Sendable protocols while platform-specific behavior stays in application targets, preserving portability and actor-boundary safety.

nodes.label: Canonical Network Math
nodes.rationale: IPv4 and subnet calculations are centralized in NetworkUtilities to prevent divergent implementations.

nodes.label: Adaptive Scan Engine
nodes.rationale: The engine combines actor-isolated accumulation, RTT-derived timeouts, thermal-aware connection limits, cancellation, and resume state to scan safely under changing runtime conditions.

nodes.label: Deterministic Scan Engine Tests
nodes.rationale: Engine and pipeline behavior are tested with local FixturePhase implementations to avoid real network I/O and keep concurrency tests deterministic.
